name: paper-canvas-workflow
description: Structure academic papers, research flows, rebuttals, camera-ready plans, and final camera-ready manuscripts in Obsidian Canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Manage academic paper workflows in Obsidian Canvas.
interface.longDescription: Build sentence-level manuscript layouts, research-flow graphs, reviewer rebuttal grids, camera-ready change maps, and final camera-ready manuscript groups while preserving the spatial grammar of an existing Obsidian Canvas.
defaultPrompt: Map this paper into a sentence-level Obsidian Canvas.
Organize these reviewer comments into a rebuttal workflow.
Map camera-ready changes onto paper_v2 without rewriting it.
Create paper_camera_ready and mark revised manuscript nodes yellow.
